title: woodsia ilvensis subsp. hyperborea
intro: Woodsia ilvensis subsp. hyperborea, commonly known as the arctic woodsia fern, is a subspecies of fern belonging to the genus Woodsia. It is native to the arctic regions of the northern hemisphere. The arctic woodsia fern has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and it is believed to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties.
